column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier for a buyer (acquirer) account. PK.
BIGINT. Age of the buyer’s profile in days. Example: 326.
BIGINT. Number of purchases made by the buyer. Example: 10.
TEXT. Authentication level attained by the buyer. **NULL means authentication level has not been determined.**. Possible values: Advanced, Basic.
